Typical values of model covariates

Source: R/data-slice.R, R/gamm4-methods.R
typical_values.Rd

Typical values of model covariates

Usage

typical_values(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'gam'
typical_values(object, vars = everything(), data = NULL, ...)

# S3 method for class 'data.frame'
typical_values(object, vars = everything(), ...)

# S3 method for class 'gamm4'
typical_values(object, ...)

Arguments

object

a fitted GAM(M) model.

...

arguments passed to other methods.

vars

terms to include or exclude from the returned object. Uses tidyselect principles.

data

an optional data frame supplying covariate classes. By default, these are taken from the stored model frame; typical values come from the fitted model's covariate summaries.
